meta_description: Danny's Home & Garden offers professional garden design, maintenance and landscaping across Birmingham. Expert local gardener with 15+ years' experience. Get a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces. Danny handles everything from design to maintenance across Birmingham.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full redesign or regular upkeep, Danny delivers expert garden work tailored to your space and budget.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden plans that make the most of your space. From patio layouts to planting schemes, Danny creates outdoor areas you'll actually use and love.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Pruning
services.desc: Keep your garden neat and healthy with regular hedge trimming and shrub pruning. Safe, tidy work with all waste cleared.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Overgrown mess? Danny clears the lot—dead plants, rubbish, brambles—leaving you with a clean slate to work from.

services.title: Lawn Care & Grass Treatment
services.desc: A healthy lawn needs expert care. Aeration, scarification, feeding, and seasonal treatments keep your grass thick and green.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Cleaning
services.desc: Pressure washing and careful cleaning restore patios, driveways, and paths to like-new condition without damage.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or monthly upkeep keeps your garden looking sharp. Weeding, edging, seasonal tidy-ups, and planting work.

about_pullquote: I started because I love seeing people enjoy their gardens—not wrestling with them every weekend.
about_para_1: Danny's Home & Garden began 15 years ago in Birmingham with a simple idea: professional gardening should be affordable and personal. What started as one man with a van has grown into a trusted local name, handling everything from tiny courtyard gardens to ambitious landscaping projects across Greater Birmingham. Danny knows the local soil, the weather challenges, and the plants that genuinely thrive here.
about_para_2: Customers come back because Danny treats every garden like his own. He listens, he doesn't oversell, and he leaves your space tidy and exactly as promised. Whether you need a one-off clear-up or ongoing care, you're dealing with someone who actually knows plants and genuinely cares about the result.

reviews.text: Had a completely overgrown garden that I didn't know where to start with. Danny came round, gave me a free quote, and got stuck in the following week. Brilliant job—tidy, professional, and reasonably priced. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Been using Danny for garden maintenance for three years now. He comes every month, keeps everything looking smart, and genuinely cares about the plants. Can't fault him—reliable, friendly, and knows his stuff.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Cleared our entire back garden, laid new turf, and created raised beds for veg. The attention to detail was impressive—he even marked out the planting zones. Honest pricing and a really nice bloke to work with.
reviews.author: John W.
